title: Funding Terms for Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Plans
content:
Funding is the moment an approved Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing loan is paid to the contract it finances. The funding terms are the same on all six plans.

| Funding term | Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 12 | Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 18 | Ridgeline Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 | Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 60 | Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 120 | Ridgeline Low-Payment 144 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Funds only after the customer signs the installation completion certificate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Business days after installation completion within which the loan is funded | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |

## Reading the terms

- On every plan the signed installation completion certificate comes before funding; the loan does not fund on an unsigned certificate.
- The funding window is counted in business days after installation completion, not in calendar days.
